h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Sagar

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Sagar

items.pText: Sagar takes its name from the large lake at its centre and is known as a university and cantonment town in the Bundelkhand region of Madhya Pradesh. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to institutions, schools, colonies and public gardens here. We make every piece at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 780 km away, and transport it by road.

Institutional buyers in Sagar often need to compare quotes from several suppliers. That only works if each supplier quotes against the same requirement. A short written brief, with the site size, the age groups, the number of children and the surface you want, saves a lot of back and forth. Send it to us with photos and we will reply with suggested equipment, a layout drawing and a quote.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Writing a playground brief for a Sagar institution

c: A useful brief covers four points. State the clear length and width of the site and mark any trees, drains or slopes. Give the age range and how many children may play at once. Say whether you need shade, seating or
such as benches. Finally, specify the materials you expect, for example galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic, along with warranty terms.

Ask every supplier to show the safe play area on a drawing. Without it, two quotes for the same items can need very different amounts of space. Bundelkhand summers are hot and dry, so include shade in the brief. See also our

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 780 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: What details should we include when asking for a playground quote?
items.a: Site length and width, photos, the age group of the children, the number using it at one time and any preference on colours, shade or surfacing. With these we can prepare a layout and an accurate quote.

items.q: Do you provide drawings for approval by a committee or department?
items.a: Yes. Every quote comes with a layout drawing that shows each piece and the safe play area around it. Committees and engineering departments can review this before placing an order.

items.q: What warranty can we write into our requirement?
items.a: Our standard warranty is three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts. It covers manufacturing defects.
